description: Six-input mixer for audio or control voltage, summing at unity gain

params.text: Attenuates the summed output; at 100% the module adds its inputs without changing the level

inputs.text: One of the six signals summed into the output

outputs.text: The sum of the patched inputs, after the LEVEL knob

menu: Invert output — multiplies the output by -1, which flips the phase of audio or the direction of a control voltage
Average voltages — divides the output by the number of patched inputs, so mixing several full-range signals keeps the output in the same range
